PR opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/infisuite-reverse-engineering/pull/1

**Outcome: genuine external blocker, re-confirmed — not the objective completed as originally scoped.**

I re-verified the repo state first (only `tickets-dashboard.md` existed, no ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml/MASTER-TRACKER.yaml in this repo to register against, no open PRs on this scope), then attempted login for all 6 role accounts fresh. All 6 fail identically with a clean `302 → login.php?error=`. I captured the raw HTTP request/response trace to prove this is a server-side rejection of a well-formed login POST (no CSRF token, correct field names/values) rather than a client-side or automation bug — ruling out the most likely alternative explanation.

Since every one of the 6 accounts is required just to reach the per-role documentation and ticket-lifecycle trace the task asked for, none of that is achievable from black-box browser exploration. Rather than fabricate unobserved role behavior, I documented the blocker with full evidence (`00-BLOCKER-login-failures-2026-07-26.md`), wrote an honest `SUMMARY.md` covering what could/couldn't be produced plus the (limited) inferred data model, updated `PROGRESS.md`, and opened a WIP PR.

This needs the system owner to provision or reset the 6 Tickday ticketing accounts before the actual 6-role reverse-engineering can proceed.
